Shaping what’s next in healthcare business

HEALTHCON 2026 by AAPC isn’t just another conference. It’s where transformation begins—where revenue cycle professionals come together to shape what’s next in healthcare business.

Whether you work hands-on with claims or set the strategy for your organization, HEALTHCON 2026 will deliver practical insights to elevate your performance and drive better results across your team.

Join the world's largest healthcare business training and credentialing organization for an experience rooted in real-world applications, interactive learning, and personalized takeaways you can put to work right away. From dynamic keynotes and lively panel discussions to our signature Ask the Experts series, every session is designed to equip you with strategic tools, innovative ideas, and the confidence to lead change.

Your career. Your conference.

At HEALTHCON 2026, education comes first—and it shows. Customize your learning experience with expert-led sessions tailored to your role(s). Every session is built to deliver real-world value, giving you working solutions to boost accuracy, improve performance, and stay ahead of industry change.

  • Explore the latest trends, updates, and regulations

  • Learn the latest best practices in various aspects of the revenue cycle

  • Strengthen your confidence through hands-on, applicable education

  • Get answers from respected leaders during Q&As and panel discussions

  • Engage with peers who understand your challenges

  • Build meaningful connections that support your professional growth
